lines.en: - Oh, my God! How did you get back here?
- Baby buffet?
- Fire alarm?
- Oh, hi, officer. Fireman, can I help you?
- You found your fire alarm in the trash chute.
- Mm-hmm. That's not mine.
- Yes, it is. - How do you know?
- The next time you want to dump a fire alarm
in the trash chute, don't wrap it in a blanket
that says, "Property of Phoebe Buffet," not Monica.
- Okay, do you have a search warrant?
Because the last time I checked, this was still America.
- Please reattach this.
It's against the law to disconnect them.
- Fine. But please, God, tell me
how to stop it from going off?
- Just press the reset button under the plastic cover.
- There's a reset button?
Oh, thank you. Thank you.
Oh, there's a reset button?
My God!
Why didn't I see that?
Reset button. Reset button.
Where's our reset button?
Oh, here it is! Oh!
Oh, my God.
